title: Pointless Piglins
description: A gamerule to prevent naturally-spawned zombified piglins from carrying golden spears.
body:
### **Pointless Piglins — Zombified Piglins Without Golden Spears**

Tired of getting chain-killed by golden-spear-wielding zombified piglins in your gold farm? This mod adds a gamerule (/gamerule pointless-piglins:disableGoldenSpear) that prevents naturally-spawned zombified piglins from carrying golden spears. Spawn eggs, commands, and structure-spawned piglins are unaffected.

### **Pointless Piglins — 僵尸猪灵不再带金矛**

厌倦了金农场里被拿着金矛的僵尸猪灵意外连杀？这个 Mod 添加了一个 gamerule（/gamerule pointless-piglins:disableGoldenSpear），开启后自然生成的僵尸猪灵就不会再持有金矛了。不影响刷怪蛋、指令召唤或结构生成的僵尸猪灵。
